title: Sixteen-comparison range scanner with loop-free prefix dispatch

claims.statement: For uniform full-production secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the complete cold classical algorithm in proof.md and baseline-proof.md recovers x with success at least 0.3900001 under their explicitly stated ideal-coin, scalar-machine and delivery conventions. Its total charged work is at most 2^125.361693 target-group-operation equivalents at C=1000, including all preprocessing, failures, transfers, coordination, verification and output. Memory is at most 2^135.9988 bytes, preprocessing at most 2^110.2061 units, and advice zero. The six-leaf construction has q1=145286892 and q2=2^25, with candidate/request/relay capacities 2^28,2^29,2^30. The sixteen-comparison scanner enumerates the same K2-adjacent matches within each d4 range as the supplied earlier range scanner, but has universal cost (29/8)*n+24*b+4*(CAND_CAP+1)+2 for n records across b ranges. Its prefix is dispatched by four TBZ tests and at most one unconditional branch, not a lookup oracle. All 184-bit matching-event, 144-bit intruder and conditional dependent-pair arguments remain supplied and unchanged. The exact full ledger is 54654977997783206975291392591997355163648 instructions. This is an analytical computation bound, not a full-size run or a claim of physical feasibility.

experiments.purpose: Production-field six-leaf/inversion checks, 4x4 routing with every delivery, exact path-count models, full-cap cases, 1200 isolated range-scanner cases, toy collision controls and exact cost/success arithmetic. No production-scale attack.
